Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages sixty-one to seventy, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: speed limits, stopping and warning-light distances, passing sight distance, emergency-vehicle following distance, load lengths and flag sizes, insurance minimums and fines, tint percentages and move-over speed reductions are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual; insurance fines and agency contact lines are administrative details that can change.
Accuracy flags: none open; the no-passing-zone and school bus pictures on physical pages sixty-four and sixty-six were not read as pictures and only their printed text was used, the agency phone and email lines on physical page seventy were left out as administrative contacts, and the load sentence on physical page sixty-nine about how far a load may extend on passenger vehicles uses a word that reads as a misprint, so no fact was taken from it.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.
